runtime.description: Client/server shared runtime (ECS worlds, networking transport, physics) - ADR-0001, ADR-0002, ADR-0003, ADR-0006. Not needed to build the offline asset-cooking tool alone.

tools.description: Offline asset-cooking tool's native bindings (tools/asset-pipeline/cooking) - ADR-0016, ADR-0017, ADR-0030. USD stage walking is pure Python (usd-optimize's pip-installed pxr build) instead, deliberately not vcpkg's usd port - see that directory's CMakeLists.txt. Not needed by the client or server runtime.
